title: A Sales By Customer filter from before the release keeps its options
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a bookmark, made before the release was installed, of Sales By Customer with only one Product Type option selected: the parts option.
  • Open the design picture "sbc-00-b-sbc-filter.png" (board 5.0) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size), so you can see how the filter looked before the release. Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • With the release installed, use a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Open the bookmarked Sales By Customer link.
  2. Open the Sales Type filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report opens with the same choice applied.

Step 2:

  • The same option is selected under its new name, "Part Sales".
  • The filter reads "Sales Type: Part Sales".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-E1: “A saved or bookmarked Sales By Customer link from before the release that carries a Product Type choice opens with the same options selected, under the new names. Report filters are kept in the page link, not saved between visits.”
  • S8-R8: “With both options selected, the filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales". With one, it reads that option's name, for example "Sales Type: Part Sales". With none, it reads "Sales Type: No sales".”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 29: “29. (a) A saved or bookmarked link with the old Product Type choice opens with the same options ticked, under the new names. The browser-saved setting in the Sales By Customer spec is out of date.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
